paragraphs.zh: 0.67 g (1.97 mmol) 2-Chlor-4-methylsulfonyl-3-phenoxymethyl-benzoesäure wurden in 30 ml Methylenchlorid mit 2 Tropfen N,N-Dimethylformamid und 0.76 g (5.9 mmol) Oxalylchlorid versetzt und 2.5 h unter Rückfluß gekocht. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer abgezogen, der Rückstand in 30 ml Methylenchlorid aufgenommen und bei 0 °C mit 0.24 g (2.16 mmol) Cyclohexandion und 0.60 g (5.9 mmol) Triethylamin versetzt. Man ließ 4 h bei Raumtemperatur nachrühren. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer eingeengt und chromatographisch gereinigt (Kieselgel, Essigester:Hexan = 1:1).
paragraphs.en: 0.67 g (1.97 mmol) of 2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-phenoxymethyl-benzoic acid in 30 ml of methylene chloride were treated with 2 drops of N,N-dimethylformamide and 0.76 g (5.9 mmol) of oxalyl chloride and boiled under reflux for 2.5 h. It was then stripped off on the rotary evaporator, the residue was taken up in 30 ml of methylene chloride and treated at 0 °C with 0.24 g (2.16 mmol) of cyclohexanedione and 0.60 g (5.9 mmol) of triethylamine. It was left to stir on for 4 h at room temperature. It was then concentrated on the rotary evaporator and purified chromatographically (silica gel, ethyl acetate:hexane = 1:1).
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication (WO 00/21924, PCT/EP99/06627) and not Chinese; the field name is the repo convention. First paragraph on the page; it is the continuation of a Schritt 2 (Step 2) preparation whose heading stands on the preceding page, so the paragraph begins mid-procedure. 'Rueckfluss' is printed with eszett ('Rueckfluß'), pre-1996-reform spelling, kept as printed. 'Cyclohexandion' is printed without a locant; the drawn/named product in Schritt 3 below is a cyclohexan-1,3-dion, but the locants are not printed here and have not been added. 'Essigester' is the German trade term for ethyl acetate and is translated as such. A small stray ink speck sits above the line in the right half of the third printed line (just after 'Anschließend wurde am'); it is a scan artifact, not a character.

paragraphs.notes: Printed on its own line with the label 'Ausbeute:' followed by wide whitespace before the value; the run of spaces is as printed. Space before the percent sign is as printed ('60 %').

Spectroscopic data with no German prose in it, so zh and en are the same string. The '1' of '1H' is printed as a superscript and the '3' of CDCl3 as a subscript; both are flattened to inline digits here. The delta is printed as the Greek letter. No terminal full stop is printed on this line.

Printed as a hanging-indent heading: 'Schritt 3:' in the left margin, the compound name starting at a deep indent and wrapping onto a second line that breaks after 'cyclohexan-1,3-' with 'dion' alone on the wrapped line. The line-break hyphen after '1,3-' is part of the printed name (cyclohexan-1,3-dion) and not a soft hyphen, so nothing was removed when the two lines were joined.

paragraphs.zh: 0.51 g (1.17 mmol) 3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chlor-4-methylsulfonyl-3-phenoxymethyl-benzoesäure, 1 Tropfen Acetoncyanhydrin und 0.21 g (2.04 mMol) Triethylamin wurden in 20 ml Acetonitril gelöst und über Nacht bei Raumtemperatur gerührt. Anschließend wurde am Rotationsverdampfer eingeengt, mit 5 ml Wasser versetzt und mit 5 M HCl sauer gestellt. Es wurde mit Essigester extrahiert, mit Wasser gewaschen, über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt. Es wurde mit Essigester extrahiert, mit Wasser gewaschen, über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt.
paragraphs.en: 0.51 g (1.17 mmol) of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-phenoxymethyl-benzoic acid, 1 drop of acetone cyanohydrin and 0.21 g (2.04 mmol) of triethylamine were dissolved in 20 ml of acetonitrile and stirred overnight at room temperature. It was then concentrated on the rotary evaporator, treated with 5 ml of water and acidified with 5 M HCl. It was extracted with ethyl acetate, washed with water, dried over MgSO4 and concentrated to dryness on the rotary evaporator. It was extracted with ethyl acetate, washed with water, dried over MgSO4 and concentrated to dryness on the rotary evaporator.
paragraphs.notes: The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication (WO 00/21924, PCT/EP99/06627) and not Chinese; the field name is the repo convention. The final sentence is printed twice, word for word ('Es wurde mit Essigester extrahiert ... vollständig eingeengt.'); the duplication is in the original and has been transcribed as printed rather than collapsed. 'mMol' is printed with a capital M here where the rest of the page prints 'mmol'; kept as printed and translated as mmol. The starting material is printed as '3-Oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chlor-...-benzoesäure', i.e. an enol-ester name given the head word 'benzoesäure' (benzoic acid) rather than an ester ending; translated literally rather than corrected to 'benzoate'. The '4' of MgSO4 is printed as a subscript and is flattened to an inline digit here.
